vps-audit is a lightweight, dependency-free Bash script designed for comprehensive security and performance auditing of Linux servers. It checks SSH configuration, firewall status, intrusion prevention, system updates, running services, open ports, and more, providing real-time feedback and detailed reports with actionable recommendations.
